roleDetails: I am Sajan, a Full Stack Architect who designs the whole stack, not just the surface. I turn complex ideas into reliable, high-performance digital products.With deep engineering experience, I specialize in architecting scalable microservices, deploying robust cloud infrastructures, and crafting pixel-perfect, highly responsive frontend interfaces. My expertise is anchored by advanced knowledge of React, Node.js, Java Spring Boot, AWS, and modern web technologies.I build systems that don't just work—they scale effortlessly. From designing complex CI/CD pipelines to optimizing database performance and ensuring seamless UI/UX, my approach is entirely holistic. I believe in writing code that is as elegant under the hood as it is on the screen.Having engineered solutions for fast-paced tech startups and enterprise environments, I thrive on solving the hardest technical problems. I don't just write code; I engineer scalable digital systems that drive actual business growth.

experience.note: Valuefy Solutions is a data-driven wealth management platform founded in 2010 by Vivek Singal and Sharad Singh. It focuses on integrating finance, technology, and user experience to enhance wealth management operations. The platform is designed to empower banks, wealth managers, and family offices by providing a unified solution for client interactions, portfolio management, and compliance, enabling faster and more accurate decision-making.

points: Shipped Angular modules across 4 banking and wealth management deployments with 0 critical bugs over 12 months using shared component libraries.
Engineered data-driven Angular components with multi-validation checks, reducing UI/UX layout development time by 30% for fluid client requirements.
Incorporated the simple-keyboard package into legacy Form.io components, onboarding international clients requiring virtual Chinese and Arabic input.
Strengthened production security using Webpack obfuscation, achieving a 100% reduction in unauthorized client-side reverse-engineering and data-tampering attempts.

Built an HTML-to-PDF engine using Puppeteer and Cheerio, implementing backward-compatible layouts that cut generation time by 50% and formatting complaints from 8/month to 0. Seamlessly linked the backend with React.

Designed a user-onboarding module using Node.js to dynamically link complex entity relationships (beneficiaries/directors) and generate unified multi-party corporate documentation, reducing documentation time by 40%.
Provisioned and exposed secure RESTful APIs using Spring MVC, Spring Security OAuth2, and OpenAPI specifications, ensuring reliable integration with internal and downstream enterprise systems.
Implemented stateless authentication and session caching by integrating JWT tokens with Redis, optimizing microservice security and reducing token validation latency.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design resilient services with fault-tolerant messaging, retry handling, and graceful degradation suitable for mission-critical financial systems.
Spearheaded production debugging initiatives using advanced telemetry tools, reducing system downtime by identifying and resolving critical, non-reproducible runtime anomalies.
Accelerated developer velocity by designing an AI-assisted workflow with custom prompt libraries, adopted by the core team to standardize output consistency.
Deployed 15+ Java/Spring Boot microservices to perform real-time data transformation and stream processing, utilizing Kafka for high-throughput message routing.
Architected high-integrity ETL pipelines by benchmarking and implementing data flows using NiFi, Airbyte, and Talend.

experience.note: A company which help enterprises scale AI, modernize data platforms, and accelerate cloud transformation.

points: Streamlined client QA workflows using C#/.NET, reducing testing time by 30% while increasing test coverage.
Optimized UI with auto-fill, component filtering, and load time reduction, cutting client software usage time by 40%.
Integrated the Azure DevOps REST API to extract and visualize project data, delivering the solution within 1 week.

recommendations.name: Aditi Pareek
recommendations.text: I had the opportunity to work alongside Sajan at Valuefy. When I joined as an intern, he was one of the engineers I frequently reached out to whenever I got stuck on frontend or backend challenges. No matter how basic or complex the question was, he always took the time to explain concepts clearly and patiently. One of Sajan's biggest strengths is his problem-solving approach. He has a knack for breaking down complex issues into smaller, manageable parts, which helps him identify root causes efficiently and build effective solutions. His analytical mindset, combined with strong full-stack development expertise, enables him to tackle challenges with confidence. Although we worked on different projects, we often collaborated through discussions and knowledge sharing. He is a quick learner, communicates ideas effectively, and is always willing to help others understand the bigger picture. I also appreciated his openness to learning from others and collaborating across teams whenever needed. Sajan is a skilled engineer, a supportive teammate, and someone who consistently approaches problems with both technical depth and practicality. I would highly recommend him to any team looking for a strong full-stack developer with excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

recommendations.text: I had the opportunity to work with Sajan. He's a fast learner. Over the course of our time together, he worked across multiple tech stacks and adapted to each one.
